title: Only a department's team leader signs its team leader step
description: Until 30 Sep a manager could be ticked as leading every department, which let them sign another department's team leader step. Leading a department now requires the team leader role, and the four leave requests signed that way went back to the right team leader.
items: A department can only be assigned to someone who holds the team leader role
Removing someone's team leader role removes the departments they led
Three VizBytes leaves go back to Amier, and one VizBooks leave to Joel as team leader, then to the manager again
